headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to coordinate efforts to promote diversity and inclusion in the federal workforce.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a coordinated, government-wide effort to promote diversity and inclusion among people who work for the federal government. Based on its title, it directs federal agencies to work together on this goal rather than acting separately. No summary was provided, so specific requirements, deadlines, and which offices lead the effort are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Their agencies are directed to take part in a coordinated effort on diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
Federal hiring and recruiting may be shaped by the agencies' diversity and inclusion efforts.
They are directed to take part in a shared, government-wide initiative on workforce diversity and inclusion.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 18, 2011; executive orders generally take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
